page.description: Plugins add commands from trusted tools. They are downloaded from allowed GitHub repositories, and every file is checked against the release checksums before anything runs.
page.emptyDescription: Install one from the allowed repositories below.
page.availableDescription: Latest releases of the repositories in Sources.
page.nothingAvailable: Everything from the allowed repositories is installed.
page.uninstallDescription: {name} and its commands will be removed. Running commands are not stopped.
page.sourcesDescription: GitHub repositories plugins may be installed from. A repository is checked before it is added: its latest release must hold a valid Canopy plugin.
page.noSources: No repository is allowed yet: plugins cannot be installed.
page.removeSourceDescription: Its releases will no longer be offered. A plugin already installed from it stays installed but can no longer be updated.

saved.title: Saved values
saved.description: Name the values people should not have to type: a screen, a server address, a port. Forms offer them by name and start with the first one.
